description: Who may write contact-organization memberships (sprk_contactorganization). Owner decision 2026-10-28 (issue #2382): contact-organization membership writes move to the Access Administrator role. The writer role holds Create, Read, Write and Append at Global; the listed read-only roles keep ONLY Read and Share (owner rounds 132 and 134). 'allowedWriterRoles' lists every live role expected to hold a membership write privilege (Create, Write, Delete, Assign or Append), each with its reason; the script's -Verify fails on any other. An entry marked 'platformRole' is allowed only while no person (non-application user) and no team holds it, which -Verify reads. tests/Spaarke.ArchTests/ContactOrganizationMembershipWriterGuardTests.cs checks the role XML; scripts/Set-WizardLinkingAndMembershipPrivileges.ps1 applies it to an environment.
